name: novamp-pitfalls
title: NovaMP v1.0 Self-Healing Error Database
description: NovaMP-specific errors with ranked fixes. Upvote fixes that work, downvote those that don't. After enough votes, fixes with score < -3 should be deprecated.

OSError: [Errno 110] ETIMEDOUT.context: NTP sync failure — usually Wi-Fi not connected

fixes.action: Verify WiFi.connect() returned True before calling TimeSyncer.sync()
Check ntptime.timeout setting — default may be too low for slow networks
Test with sync(force=True) to bypass 4h cache
Ensure firewall allows UDP/123 outbound (some corporate networks block NTP)

OSError: [Errno 113] EHOSTUNREACH.context: Cannot reach NTP server — DNS or routing issue

fixes.action: Check wifi.dns is set correctly
Try ping 8.8.8.8 to verify IP connectivity
Some routers isolate IoT devices — check AP isolation settings

RuntimeError: PWM initialization failed.context: PWM cannot be initialized — pin doesn't support PWM

fixes.action: GPIO 34-39 are input-only on ESP32 — use a different pin
Check if pin is already used by another PWM channel — deinit first
GPIO 6-11 are connected to flash — do NOT use

ValueError: pin is input-only.context: Tried to use GPIO 34-39 as output

fixes.action: Move to GPIO 2, 4, 5, 12-33 — these support output
If you need analog input on these pins, use ADC class instead
Call gc.collect() before large allocations
Wi-Fi + TLS consumes 50-80KB — keep heap usage low
Reduce buffer sizes in libraries (e.g., requests response buffer)
Avoid string concatenation in loops — use list + join
Press Ctrl+C to break out, then Ctrl+D for soft reset
Send Ctrl+E to enter paste mode before pasting code blocks
Check signal strength: WiFi.scan() and verify RSSI > -80 dBm
Verify SSID and password case-sensitive match
5GHz networks not supported — use 2.4GHz only
WPA3-Enterprise not supported in v1.0 — use WPA2-PSK
Some NovaMP builds don't include ntptime — connect via mpremote and run: mip.install('ntptime')
Verify NovaMP version — v1.0 should include ntptime by default
Echo pin is 5V — add voltage divider (1kΩ + 2kΩ) to step down to 3.3V
VCC needs 5V (not 3.3V) — check power supply
Object out of range (>4m) — increase echo_timeout_us
Driver rounds to 0.01° — but if calling move_to() rapidly, jitter appears
Add sleep_ms(20) after move_to() to let servo settle
External 5V supply recommended — undervoltage causes jitter
For batched updates: set immediate=False, then call write() once at end
WS2812B needs 5V power — check supply (USB often insufficient for full brightness)
Data line too long — keep <1m or use level shifter

TimeSyncer.now() shows wrong time.context: Local time displays UTC or off by hours

fixes.action: Pass timezone= parameter to TimeSyncer constructor (default is 8 = Beijing)
If RTC was set manually to local time, use http_time() for UTC instead
Known issue: now() uses mktime() which interprets tuple as local. See time_sync.json known_issues.

WiFi credentials persist unexpectedly.context: WiFi auto-reconnects with old credentials after soft-reset

fixes.action: This is ESP32 NVS behavior — call wlan.active(False) before soft_reset to clear
For full clear: wlan.active(False); gc.collect(); soft_reset
Check H-bridge power supply (separate from ESP32)
Verify IN1/IN2 pins match wiring — swap if needed or use direction=-1
Use external power supply rated for motor stall current (typically 1-2A)

Microphone reads always 0.context: mic.value always returns 0 even with sound

fixes.action: Check mic module power — many need 3.3V or 5V depending on model
Verify ADC pin — GPIO 32-39 only (ADC1)
Some mic modules have digital output — need analog-output module for ADC

Voting instructions.description: When applying a fix from this database:
rules: Fix has score < -3 → deprecate it (remove from list)
Discovered new error → add new entry following existing schema
Discovered new fix → add to existing error's fixes list
